description: This file implements the CartRepository class which manages shopping cart state, persistence, and synchronization with a backend API in an Android Kotlin project. It handles adding, updating, removing items, migrating local cache to backend, and maintains reactive state flows for UI updates and error reporting.

classes.name: CartRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing cart data and synchronization with backend in a thread-safe and reactive manner.

methods.name: setActiveEmail
methods.description: Sets the active user email, initiates migration of local cache to backend, and refreshes cart from backend.

methods.name: ensureCartLoaded
methods.description: Ensures the cart data is loaded from backend at least once for the current identity.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a product with specified quantity to the cart, updates local state, and attempts backend synchronization.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Sets absolute quantity for a cart item and syncs update with backend.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart and updates backend accordingly.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all cart items locally and on backend.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Calculates and returns cart summary including total quantity and subtotal.

methods.name: groupedByCategory
methods.description: Returns cart items grouped by category, sorted by category name.

methods.name: refreshFromBackend
methods.description: Fetches cart data from backend and reconciles local state.

methods.name: migrateLocalCacheToBackendIfNeeded
methods.description: Merges local cache items into backend cart on first identity setup.

methods.name: reconcileFromCartDto
methods.description: Reconciles local cart state with data received from backend.

methods.name: setAndPersist
methods.description: Sets the in-memory cart state and persists it locally.

methods.name: emitError
methods.description: Emits an error event with message and operation details.
